thesis: Positive 20/60-bar momentum supports the bull case, but negative FCF and missing multi-period evidence prevent a confident direction.
strongest_counterexample: A bull counterexample is price above SMA-50/200 with positive 20/60-bar returns and forward P/E below trailing P/E.
invalidation_conditions: A future dated report showing sustained positive FCF would weaken the bear case.
A decline below the observed 60-bar low would weaken the technical bull case.
evidence_gaps: No dated multi-period cash-flow or margin series.
Current contract backlog and project-level cash conversion are not supplied.
No USD/MYR snapshot; undated recommendation buckets were excluded.
decisive_factors: Positive 20/60-bar returns and above-average trend position.
Negative reported FCF and high debt relative to equity.
No dated operating news confirms a structural turnaround.
